units.title: Academic Vocabulary / Léxico académico

grammar.explanation_es: En registro académico se usan conectores formales (furthermore, consequently) y nominalización para sonar objetivo.
examples: The findings are significant; furthermore, they are replicable.
Consequently, the hypothesis was rejected.
Nevertheless, further research is required.
The data imply a strong correlation.
This framework underlies the entire study.

story.text: The study presents a ___ analysis of the data. ___ , the results suggest a strong correlation. The authors ___ that the findings are robust. ___ , they acknowledge certain limitations. Further research is ___ to confirm the conclusions.

sentences: The data imply a strong correlation.
The findings are significant and replicable.

units.title: Complex Grammar / Gramática avanzada

grammar.explanation_es: Para enfatizar, invertimos sujeto y auxiliar: 'Not only did he win, but he also broke a record', 'Seldom have I seen such talent'.
examples: Not only did he win, but he also broke a record.
Seldom have I seen such talent.
Had I known, I would have helped.
No sooner had we arrived than it started to rain.
Under no circumstances should you give up.

story.text: ___ only is the report detailed, but it is also persuasive. ___ have I read such a compelling argument. ___ I known the deadline, I would have started earlier. No ___ had they finished than new issues arose. Were it ___ for her support, the project would have failed.

sentences: Seldom have I seen such talent.
Had I known I would have helped.
Not only did he win the prize.
No sooner had we arrived than it rained.

grammar.explanation_es: En debate formal matizamos (hedging) y concedemos puntos: 'Granted, that's true, but...', 'I would argue that...'.
examples: I would argue that education is the key.
Granted, the cost is high, but the benefits outweigh it.
On the contrary, the evidence suggests otherwise.
Let me play devil's advocate for a moment.
That said, we must bear the risks in mind.

units.title: Professional World / Mundo profesional

grammar.explanation_es: Para enfatizar: 'What we need is more time', 'It is efficiency that matters most'.
examples: What we need is a clearer strategy.
It is accountability that drives results.
What matters most is the outcome.
It was her leadership that saved the project.
What I suggest is that we streamline the process.

story.text: To ensure success, every ___ must be aligned on the goals. The team agreed to ___ the workflow to improve ___ . After reaching the first ___ , they renegotiated the project ___ to keep it feasible.

sentences: What we need is a clearer strategy.
It is accountability that drives results.
The plan is feasible within the scope.

units.title: Nuance & Style / Matices y estilo

grammar.explanation_es: Matizar el grado de certeza: 'It may well be...', 'arguably', 'to a certain extent'.
examples: It may well be the best solution.
This is, arguably, his finest work.
The argument is compelling, albeit complex.
Notwithstanding the risks, they proceeded.
To a certain extent, I agree.

story.text: The author offers a ___ analysis that is ___ , though not without flaws. ___ the complexity, the central idea is easy to ___ . ___ , this book provides genuine ___ into human behavior.

sentences: It may well be the best solution.
This is arguably his finest work.
The argument is compelling albeit complex.
To a certain extent I agree with you.
